desc: milkdrop's warp field chewing the frame into itself

params.name: zoom
params.help: suck the frame into the middle or blow it outward — 1:1 at halfway, and the bass pumps it in

params.name: spin
params.help: which way the field turns and how hard — still at halfway, either direction from there

params.name: warp
params.help: the sine ripple bending the flow; 0 is a clean zoom, top of the knob knots it

params.name: video
params.help: how strongly the live picture seeds the field — low leaves a ghost, high keeps it sharp
